correctness.rationale: Both counterexamples satisfy the source definitions on a counting-measure space with one-dimensional coefficient spaces. In the first, all outer weaves are Parseval while the induced family e_n/n has no lower frame bound. In the second, all induced weaves are Parseval while the outer operators f -> f_n/n have no lower g-frame bound. The repair follows from the pointwise local frame inequalities after imposing uniform lower and upper constants.

value.rationale: The result concerns a structural equivalence used to turn operator-valued continuous g-weaving into ordinary continuous weaving through local coefficient-space frames. Without uniform local conditioning, either direction can fail even for diagonal Parseval data. The repair is quantitative, simple to apply, and the same missing hypothesis reappears in a later Hilbert C*-module extension.
